## Fine Offset sensors

The sensors used in the EON microclimate work are produced by `Fine Offset` and re-branded or partly modified by different resellers. This page refers mainly to sensors sold by the German reseller `froggit` and the US reseller `ecowitt`.

The relevant gateway family is the [DP-/GW SmartHub](https://www.foshk.com/Wifi_Weather_Station/GW1100.html), a WiFi gateway for temperature, humidity, and pressure measurements developed by Fine Offset. Its practical strength for field courses is the large number of compatible radio-based sensors.

### Sensor suppliers

- [Froggit shop [DE]](https://www.froggit.de/?cat=c40_Raumklima-und-Luftqualitaet---IP-Wettersysteme-dp-serie.html)
- [Ecowitt shop [US]](https://shop.ecowitt.com/collections/wifi-sensor)
- [Fine Offset](https://www.foshk.com/)

## Compatible sensor types

Depending on the gateway, up to 8 sensors of the following types can be connected at the same time:

- [DP150/WN51](https://www.froggit.de/media/products/DP150_BDA_EN.pdf) soil temperature sensors
- [DP50/WH31](https://www.froggit.de/media/products/DP50_BDA%28DE%29.pdf) multi-channel temperature and humidity sensors
- [WN34](https://osswww.ecowitt.net/uploads/20220803/WN34S%20WN34L%20Manual.pdf) wire probe thermometer
- [DP10/WN35](https://www.froggit.de/media/products/DP10_BDA_EN.pdf) leaf wetness sensors
- [DP100](https://www.froggit.de/media/products/DP100_BDA%28DE%29.pdf) soil moisture sensors

Up to 4 sensors of the following types can be connected:

- [DP200/WH41/WH43](https://www.froggit.de/media/products/DP200_BDA%28DE%29_1.pdf) PM2.5/PM10 sensors
- [WH45](https://osswww.ecowitt.net/uploads/20220803/WH55%20Manual.pdf) water leak sensors

Up to 2 sensors of the following types can be connected:

- [DP250/WH45](https://www.froggit.de/product_info.php?info=p483_dp250-5-in-1-co2-pm2-5-pm10-temperatur-luftfeuchte-innenraum-luftqualitaets-funksensor.html) CO2 / PM2.5 / PM10 / temperature / humidity indoor air quality sensor
- [DP60/WH57](https://www.froggit.de/media/products/DP60-Manual_EN_.pdf) lightning sensor

For basic weather parameters such as rainfall, wind vector, solar radiation, temperature, and humidity, compatible outdoor base units such as the [DP1100](https://www.froggit.de/media/products/DP1100_BDA_DE_.pdf) or [WH3000](https://www.froggit.de/media/products/WH3000_BDA_Ausseneinheit_DE_.pdf) can be used.

## Calibration concept

Low-budget sensors usually do not provide stable measurement quality without checks. Reliable microclimate data therefore require a calibration concept before the measurements are used for spatial modelling.

1. Measurements from all sensors should be analysed together, preferably under controlled conditions such as a climate chamber, to identify sensors with systematic or significant outliers.
2. The sensors should then be checked against an operational high-quality reference station in the field.
